info.title: Subject Advisors UC20 Forecast Planning API
info.description: PLANNED contract only. These endpoints are not implemented. Uploaded people are external-reference cohorts and are never linked to portal students or profiles.

tags.name: Imports

tags.name: Configuration

get.summary: Read configured programme, centre, semester and curriculum options
get.description: Requires an active Coordinator. Returns configured programmes, centres and semesters. With programmeId, also returns that programme's configured curriculum versions, curriculum_subject -> subject catalogue, exclusions and prerequisite expressions/conditions. This endpoint never calls student/profile/options APIs.

200.description: UTF-8 CSV header in the defined field order.

get.summary: List import summaries in a required scope
get.description: Programme, centre and target semester filters are required. The list is paginated and returns metadata/counts, not raw CSV rows. Import list rows are summaries; use import detail to retrieve the full validation report and warnings.

post.summary: Validate one CSV and accept it when all rows are valid
post.description: Fully valid uploads are accepted directly, including warnings. Row errors return a 422 correction report without accepting rejected history. Valid roster metadata is retained when a subject-history row is invalid. The file is bound to programme, centre and target semester; the server verifies all IDs against configured catalogue rows. The caller actor is derived from the verified active Coordinator session. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts. CSV v1 accepts optional UTF-8 BOM, comma/double-quote escaping and LF/CRLF; trims fields, treats trimmed-empty as blank, compares opaque external references case-sensitively (1-128 Unicode characters), allows int32 positive semester IDs and nonnegative integer credits, and limits uploads to 5 MiB/10,000 data rows. A successful accepted-import response includes the complete validation report, including nonblocking warnings; warnings remain retrievable from import detail. No raw CSV is returned.

get.summary: Read import provenance and quality summary
get.description: Returns the scoped accepted import and complete validation quality report, including nonblocking warnings; never returns raw CSV.

post.summary: Accept remaining valid rows after explicit acknowledgement
post.description: Only available for a validation with row errors and valid rows remaining. If-Match binds acknowledgement to the validation report/fingerprint revision; the validation may be accepted once. This is the uploading Coordinator's acknowledgement, not a second-person policy approval. After authentication, an idempotent replay resolves to the original receipt before current validation state is checked. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

get.summary: List runs in a required programme/centre/semester scope

post.description: Requires an accepted import matching all three scope IDs. Creates version 1 with parent null. Supported eligible-pool demand is advisory, not registration. Missing evidence creates per-student/subject uncertainty; missing capacity creates CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED on affected sections. Neither blocks unrelated supported rows. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

get.summary: Read a run and its saved assumptions

post.summary: Review or adjust sections and append audit entries
post.description: Request carries all three scope IDs; server verifies them against the stored run. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Actor, before/after values and timestamp are server-derived. Changes and append-only audits commit atomically. An idempotent replay returns the original receipt after authentication, before the current revision is checked. Idempotency keys are server-namespaced by actor, operation and programme/centre/semester; key text need not embed scope. After auth, replay lookup precedes mutable state/revision checks. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

Request carries all scope IDs and they must match the stored run. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Validate required reviews, append the final audit, and freeze in one transaction. No offering is published. Idempotency keys are server-namespaced by actor, operation and programme/centre/semester; key text need not embed scope. After auth, replay lookup precedes mutable state/revision checks. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts. Finalization is allowed only from UNDER_REVIEW after required reviews; successful finalization records non-null actor/time and freezes the run.

get.summary: Read a bounded page of append-only decisions

get.description: Active System Administrator only. This role does not gain access to cohort imports or forecasts.

put.summary: Update capacity, exclusion and stale-source configuration
put.description: Active System Administrator only. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. The API never seeds provisional capacity numbers. The new version appends configuration and never mutates rows referenced by existing runs. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

post.summary: Move an initial draft into review
post.description: Explicit DRAFT to UNDER_REVIEW transition. Scope must match the stored run. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Replay lookup follows authentication and precedes current state/revision checks. Idempotency keys are server-namespaced by actor, operation and programme/centre/semester; key text need not embed scope. After auth, replay lookup precedes mutable state/revision checks. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

ETag.description: Opaque current revision used with If-Match.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Server namespaces by authenticated actor, operation and programme/centre/semester scope.

classType.description: May be null when the canonical subject class_type is absent.

file.description: UTF-8 CSV with optional BOM, comma delimiting, doubled-quote escaping, LF or CRLF. Trim surrounding spaces; trimmed-empty is blank. At most 5 MiB and 10,000 data rows.

external_reference.description: Opaque case-sensitive source reference, 1 to 128 Unicode characters; never a portal identity.

curriculum_version.description: Blank only with exactly one configured programme curriculum version.

cohort_status.description: ACTIVE has a provisional engineering mapping to supported potential demand. Unrecognized tokens are per-student uncertainty.

subject_code.description: Blank only when the five-field attempt group is empty.

subject_status.description: Blank only when all five attempt fields are blank. WITHDRAWN is not normalized.

record_semester_id.description: Positive decimal int32 lexeme; implementations must reject numeric values above 2147483647.

recognized_credits.description: Nonnegative decimal integer no greater than verified catalogue credit hours. FAILED and IN_PROGRESS accept blank or 0 only; positive recognized credit on either is invalid.

is_synthetic.description: Blank only for a no-history row.

forecastCount.description: Null is unknown; never encode as zero.

ForecastRun.description: Checked constraint: status FINALIZED requires non-null finalizedBy/finalizedAt; DRAFT and UNDER_REVIEW require both null. Finalized runs are immutable.

oneOf.description: subjectId is the canonical subject.subject_id, not curriculum_subject_id.

replacementSections.description: Full replacement allocation for the subject. Omitted existing section IDs retire those sections from the current allocation; historical section/audit rows are retained.

oneOf.description: subjectId is the canonical subject.subject_id, not curriculum_subject_id.

effectiveToSemesterId.description: Null means no end semester; otherwise a positive canonical int32 ID.

CapacityRule.description: Semantic validation: GLOBAL has no centre or subject IDs; CENTRE requires a centre and no subject ID; SUBJECT_CENTRE requires both. minimumEnrollment <= breakEvenTarget <= normalMaximum. A non-null exceptionMaximum must be >= normalMaximum. Semester IDs are positive int32 values from the shared configured semester catalogue. Effective ranges use configured academic-year/term chronology, never numeric ID order; a non-null end must not precede its start.

effectiveToSemesterId.description: Null means no end semester; otherwise a positive canonical int32 ID.

SubjectExclusion.description: subjectId is a positive canonical int32 ID from the subject catalogue. Effective semester IDs are positive canonical int32 IDs from the shared configured semester catalogue. Effective ranges use configured academic-year/term chronology, never numeric ID order; a non-null end must not precede its start.

staleSourceMaxAgeDays.description: Null means no configured threshold; emit a warning.

ForecastConfigurationRequest.description: Create a new immutable configuration version/active pointer; never mutate capacity rows referenced by a forecast.

CurriculumRequirementSnapshot.description: Mirrors curriculum_requirement; required_subjects is a nullable nonnegative count, not an ID list.

ImportAcceptedResponse.description: Accepted immutable import or its summary; no-store.

ImportValidationResponse.description: 422 correction report. No invalid history is accepted. No-store; ETag binds a later subset acknowledgement.

ForecastRunResponse.description: Forecast and saved assumptions; no-store; ETag identifies its revision.

ForecastOperationResponse.description: Operation receipt. Replays return the original receipt, not the current mutable resource.

Forbidden.description: Active identity lacks the required verified role.

ScopeNotFound.description: Resource or configured scope unavailable; mismatched IDs are not disclosed.

Conflict.description: Idempotency mismatch, existing initial run or lifecycle conflict.

InvalidDecision.description: Decision/configuration is invalid for current state or rules.

Unavailable.description: Retryable dependency failure; SQL/provider details are not exposed.
